rationale: The answer states all five expected alternate terms associated with the more general CAPEC-94 pattern related to CAPEC-384: Man-in-the-Middle / MITM, Monkey-in-the-Middle, Monster-in-the-Middle, On-path Attacker, and Person-in-the-Middle / PiTM. It also correctly identifies CAPEC-384 and related CAPEC-94, CAPEC-385, and CAPEC-389 records. The minor weakness is that it phrases the alternate terms as if they are direct AlternateTerms of CAPEC-384, whereas the evidence ties them to CAPEC-94.
